records.name: Bhuvanagiri Hill
records.description: A prominent monolithic hill crowned by Bhuvanagiri Fort. Telangana Tourism gives the hill's height as 610 metres; this record documents the named hill and the published elevation, not a claim that it is the state's highest point.
records.referenceDate: Official Telangana Tourism destination profile accessed 31 October 2026

records.name: Forest ecosystems of Uttar Pradesh
records.description: The Forest Survey of India’s 2019 State of Forest Report classifies Uttar Pradesh’s forests into five Champion and Seth forest-type groups and 28 forest types. Reported types include Northern Dry Mixed Deciduous Forest, Anogeissus pendula Forest, Dry Siwalik Sal Forest, Western and Eastern Alluvial Plains Sal Forests, swamp forest and alluvial grassland. This is a forest-ecosystem profile, not a complete inventory of all state ecosystems.
records.referenceDate: ISFR 2019, Volume II, Chapter 11.28, especially section 11.28.3 and Table 11.28.9

records.regionName: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
records.name: Forest ecosystems — Dadra and Nagar Haveli component
records.description: The Forest Survey of India’s 2019 State of Forest Report identifies two forest-type groups in the former Dadra and Nagar Haveli Union Territory: Tropical Moist Deciduous Forests and Tropical Dry Deciduous Forests, represented by four forest types. The cited chapter covers Dadra and Nagar Haveli only, not the former Daman and Diu districts; this entry is scoped to that component of the present merged Union Territory.
records.referenceDate: ISFR 2019, Volume II, Chapter 11.33, sections 11.33.1 and 11.33.3
